articles.title: MAI-Transcribe-2 Leads David AI’s 21-Language Speech Recognition Benchmark
articles.excerpt: Microsoft AI’s MAI-Transcribe-2 achieved the lowest transcription error rate in 18 of 21 languages in David AI’s new DAI-ASR-I18N public evaluation. The result matters because the benchmark uses 147 h…
articles.body: Microsoft AI’s MAI-Transcribe-2 achieved the lowest transcription error rate in 18 of 21 languages in David AI’s new DAI-ASR-I18N public evaluation. The result matters because the benchmark uses 147 hours of unscripted conversation, a more demanding setting than clean, scripted audio and one that more closely resembles customer calls, interviews, meetings, and support recordings. According to David AI’s DAI-ASR-I18N benchmark report , MAI-Transcribe-2 stayed below 10% transcription error in 16 languages. The evaluation also found that the model remained robust when separate speaker audio was mixed into a single channel. For teams that process multilingual spoken content, the results provide independent evidence that model performance can vary significantly by language and audio setup.

articles.title: I built a free bike & hike route planner because I got tired of Komoot paywalls and surprise headwinds
articles.excerpt: Last autumn I planned a 120 km Saturday gravel ride with friends. What should have been a 5-minute map check turned into the classic modern cycling headache: I drew the loop in a popular route app, cl…
articles.body: Last autumn I planned a 120 km Saturday gravel ride with friends. What should have been a 5-minute map check turned into the classic modern cycling headache: I drew the loop in a popular route app, clicked Export GPX to send it to my bike computer, and immediately hit a paywall: "Unlock this region or subscribe to download your file." Once we finally got on the road, the weather app had promised "18°C and light breeze." What it didn't show was that the entire second half of our loop ran straight into a 35 km/h headwind across open fields. By kilometer 80, we were crawling at 12 km/h on flat ground with dead legs. And to top it off, my chain — which I had forgotten to measure all summer — started skipping across the cassette on every climb.
articles.author: Ulad Rybakou

articles.body: Use short-lived signed URLs in both directions — one that lets the browser put bytes straight into a private bucket, one that lets an authorized reader pull them back — and keep the deletion deadline in your own database instead of in a bucket rule. The deciding constraint for a property management app is not upload throughput. It's that a countersigned lease has a date on which it must stop existing, and object storage has no idea what a tenancy is. Application owns the clock. Storage owns the bytes. The system here is ordinary.

articles.title: Mastering SQL: Window Functions, Joins, CTEs and Subqueries
articles.excerpt: Introduction Basic SELECT, WHERE and GROUP BY statements answer simple questions: how many visits happened, or how much money a department earned. Real hospital analytics asks harder ones. Which docto…
articles.body: Introduction Basic SELECT, WHERE and GROUP BY statements answer simple questions: how many visits happened, or how much money a department earned. Real hospital analytics asks harder ones. Which doctor’s most expensive visit was it? How long was it between a patient’s first and second visit? Which diagnoses appeared one week and vanished the next? Which doctors earn more per visit than the hospital average? Four families of SQL tools answer these questions: window functions, joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and subqueries. This article explains each one, shows why it exists, and demonstrates it on our hospital database with a query, an explanation of what the query does, and the expected result.

articles.body: 5 min read Preparations for Next Moonwalk Simulations Underway (and Underwater) Research teams at NASA’s Glenn Research Center are involved in developing theory and software to predict the noise from aircraft engines. This software helps engineers to design and analyze new and improved aircraft propulsion systems. Copies of our software can be requested from NASA’s Software Catalog. Aerodynamic predictions of a the hot exhaust flow through a dual stream nozzle with chevrons. NASA JeNo Development of jet noise prediction codes is multifaceted. Since JeNo predicts jet noise using Lilley’s Acoustic Analogy and the mean flow solutions from a Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) code, accurate acoustic predictions hinge on accurate aerodynamic predictions.

articles.title: 'They're kind of goth': NASA spacecraft gives mysterious brown dwarfs a close-up
articles.excerpt: Using NASA’s SPHEREx spacecraft, astronomers have studied a horde of mysterious "failed stars," or brown dwarfs, not-so-stellar loners that wander the darkness of space alone.
articles.body: Using NASA’s SPHEREx spacecraft, astronomers have studied a host of "failed stars," also known as brown dwarfs. These strange cosmic bodies straddle the line between planets and stars, possessing a mass between 13 and 80 times that of Jupiter (0.013 to 0.08 times the mass of the sun ). They get the nickname failed stars because they form like stars from collapsing clouds of gas and dust but fail to gather enough mass to trigger the fusion of hydrogen to helium in their cores, the process that powers actual stars . This formation process also means that brown dwarfs are cosmic loners, wandering the darkness of space alone, bereft of the light of a parent star. articles.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
articles.excerpt: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment remini…
articles.body: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone . The agents—copies of Claude Opus 4.7 nicknamed Eko—were able to write instructions that moved their virtual avatars around the simulated island, which was loosely based on the video game Roblox. Some surprising behaviors emerged. The agents set about exploring the limits of the world and came up with their own goals—attempting to scale the highest point on the map, or seeing how high they could throw a block.

articles.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
articles.excerpt: The actions could have resulted in criminal charges had humans been behind the keyboard.
articles.body: OpenAI said internal models hacked two more websites, bypassed company-imposed browsing restrictions, and used exposed credentials to draw cryptocurrency from a wallet it couldn’t otherwise access, in the latest installment of disclosures of the unethical and likely illegal acts its agents are performing. The company on Thursday issued reports of four new incidents, all of which occurred in June. They come after the company revealed in July that internal test agents exploited a zero-day vulnerability in a tool designed to restrict their access to the Internet. They then broke into the network of AI tool provider Hugging Face. The agents took that illegal action to steal answers to a hacking test that weren’t available when completing the tasks on their own.
